documents.title: Acme Corp FY2023 Financial Report
pages: Acme Corporation Fiscal Year 2023 Annual Report. Financial Performance Summary: Acme Corporation reported total revenue of $14.2 million for fiscal year 2023, representing a growth of 12% year-over-year. Operating margin stood at 18.5% with net income of $2.6 million. Primary growth drivers were enterprise cloud software subscriptions.

Risk Factors and Operational Outlook 2023: The company identifies critical supply chain bottlenecks in hardware delivery and foreign exchange currency volatility as primary headwinds. Capital expenditures for R&D were capped at $3.1 million.

documents.title: Acme Corp FY2024 Financial Report
pages: Acme Corporation Fiscal Year 2024 Annual Report. Financial Performance Summary: Total revenue surged to $18.5 million in fiscal year 2024, an increase of 30.2% compared to 2023. Operating margin improved to 21.2% with net income expanding to $3.9 million. Software subscriptions accounted for 78% of gross bookings.

Risk Factors and Operational Outlook 2024: Key risks shifted significantly towards cross-border regulatory compliance changes and emerging cybersecurity threats. R&D capital expenditure increased to $4.8 million focused on machine learning acceleration.
